132	func (s *FileServerService) serveAttachmentFile(c *echo.Context) error {
133		ctx := c.Request().Context()

139			UID:     &uid,

142		if err != nil {
143			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment").Wrap(err)
144		}
145		if attachment == nil {
146			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "attachment not found")
147		}

149		if err := s.checkAttachmentPermission(ctx, c, attachment); err != nil {

217	func (s *FileServerService) serveMediaStream(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string) error {
218		setSecurityHeaders(c)
219		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
220	
221		switch attachment.StorageType {
222		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
223			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
224			if err != nil {
225				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
226			}
227			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
228			return nil
229	
230		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
231			presignURL, err := s.getS3PresignedURL(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
232			if err != nil {
233				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to generate presigned URL").Wrap(err)

242		}
243	}

246	func (s *FileServerService) serveStaticFile(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string, wantThumbnail bool) error {

256				return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, "image/jpeg", thumbnailBlob)
257			}
258		}
259	
260		setSecurityHeaders(c)
261		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
262	
263		// Force download for non-media files to prevent XSS execution.
264		if !strings.HasPrefix(contentType, "image/") && contentType != "application/pdf" {
265			c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentDisposition, fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=%q", attachment.Filename))
266		}
267	
268		switch attachment.StorageType {
269		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
270			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
271			if err != nil {
272				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
273			}

282			return c.Stream(http.StatusOK, contentType, reader)
283		default:
284			return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, contentType, attachment.Blob)
285		}

650	func (s *FileServerService) checkAttachmentPermission(ctx context.Context, c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
651		// For unlinked attachments, only the creator can access.
652		if attachment.MemoID == nil {
653			user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
654			if err != nil {

656			}
657			if user == nil {
658				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
659			}
660			if user.ID != attachment.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
661				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
662			}
663			return nil
664		}
665	
666		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{ID: attachment.MemoID})
667		if err != nil {
668			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to find memo").Wrap(err)
669		}
670		if memo == nil {
671			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "memo not found")
672		}
673	
674		// Public-visibility attachments are served to anonymous visitors only when the
675		// instance allows anonymous access. On a private instance (no InstanceURL), the
676		// request must still resolve to an authenticated user or a valid share token below.
677		if memo.Visibility == store.Public && s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
678			return nil
679		}
680	
681		// Check share token fallback: allow access if request carries a valid, non-expired share token
682		// that was issued for this specific memo. This covers attachment requests made from the shared
683		// memo page for private or protected memos.
684		if shareToken := (*c).QueryParam("share_token"); shareToken != "" {
685			ms, err := s.Store.GetMemoShare(ctx, &store.FindMemoShare{UID: &shareToken})
686			if err == nil && ms != nil && !isMemoShareExpired(ms) && ms.MemoID == memo.ID {

688			}

691		user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
692		if err != nil {
693			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
694		}
695		if user == nil {
696			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
697		}
698	
699		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && user.ID != memo.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
700			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
701		}
702	
703		return nil
704	}

656			}

658				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
659			}
660			if user.ID != attachment.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
661				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
662			}
663			return nil
664		}
665	
666		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{ID: attachment.MemoID})
667		if err != nil {
668			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to find memo").Wrap(err)
669		}
670		if memo == nil {
671			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "memo not found")
672		}
673	
674		// Public-visibility attachments are served to anonymous visitors only when the
675		// instance allows anonymous access. On a private instance (no InstanceURL), the
676		// request must still resolve to an authenticated user or a valid share token below.
677		if memo.Visibility == store.Public && s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
678			return nil
679		}
680	
681		// Check share token fallback: allow access if request carries a valid, non-expired share token
682		// that was issued for this specific memo. This covers attachment requests made from the shared
683		// memo page for private or protected memos.
684		if shareToken := (*c).QueryParam("share_token"); shareToken != "" {
685			ms, err := s.Store.GetMemoShare(ctx, &store.FindMemoShare{UID: &shareToken})
686			if err == nil && ms != nil && !isMemoShareExpired(ms) && ms.MemoID == memo.ID {

688			}

691		user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
692		if err != nil {
693			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
694		}
695		if user == nil {
696			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
697		}
698	
699		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && user.ID != memo.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {

701		}
702	
703		return nil
